title: Quercetin attenuates cisplatin-induced muscle atrophy via Hippo/YAP1 signaling pathway.
authors: Lv, Jingchun; Lin, Jianwei; Chen, Xiaojing; Wu, Qi; Cao, Zhiyao; Jiang, Dapeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槲皮素缓解顺铂诱导的肌肉萎缩，涉及YAP1信号通路和分子对接，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Muscle wasting is a common event among cancer patients receiving chemotherapy treatment and has been reported to affect their survival. However, current therapies for counteracting this side effect are ineffective. This study investigates quercetin's efficacy against cisplatin-induced muscle atrophy and its mechanism. Using both C2C12 myotube and mouse models, we found quercetin pretreatment significantly alleviates cisplatin-induced muscle wasting. Mechanistically, transcriptome analysis identified that the Hippo signaling pathway was involved in cisplatin-induced muscle atrophy. Quercetin restored the activity of this pathway, including the expression and nuclear localization of its effector YAP1. Furthermore, quercetin mitigated cisplatin-induced muscle damage by improving mitochondrial membrane quality and function. Molecular docking revealed a direct interaction between quercetin and YAP1. Additionally, the possible interaction between YAP1 and mitochondrial function was revealed. Our findings demonstrate that quercetin attenuates cisplatin-induced muscle atrophy by modulating the Hippo/YAP1 pathway and preserving mitochondrial homeostasis, highlighting its therapeutic potential.
abstract_zh: 肌肉萎缩是接受化疗的癌症患者中常见的现象，并已被报道影响其生存。然而，目前针对这一副作用的治疗方法效果不佳。本研究探讨了槲皮素对顺铂诱导的肌肉萎缩的疗效及其机制。利用C2C12肌管和小鼠模型，我们发现槲皮素预处理显著缓解了顺铂诱导的肌肉萎缩。在机制上，转录组分析鉴定出Hippo信号通路参与了顺铂诱导的肌肉萎缩。槲皮素恢复了该通路的活性，包括其效应因子YAP1的表达和核定位。此外，槲皮素通过改善线粒体膜质量和功能，减轻了顺铂诱导的肌肉损伤。分子对接揭示了槲皮素与YAP1之间的直接相互作用。另外，还揭示了YAP1与线粒体功能之间可能的相互作用。我们的研究结果表明，槲皮素通过调节Hippo/YAP1通路并维持线粒体稳态来减轻顺铂诱导的肌肉萎缩，凸显了其治疗潜力。
